_note: HONESTY ABOUT PRE-REGISTRATION: these were chosen with the current values already
visible, so they are targets rather than pre-registered thresholds. Calling them
pre-registered would be a fiction. The mitigation is that floors are set to catch
REGRESSION rather than to certify the present state as good, so they are deliberately
below where the system sits today rather than tuned to just barely pass.
FLOOR IS NOT TARGET. Conflating the two is how a scorecard starts failing constantly
and gets ignored, which is worse than having none. A floor says 'something broke'. A
target says 'this is where we want to get to'. Only floors gate.
Only metrics the scorer marked safe to gate appear here. agent_field_populated is
excluded because it is knowably wrong on fan-out lines; hint_query_matched_task
because its threshold is a knob; session_routed because it has no single value by

tier_declared.why: Exact denominator, log-only. A drop here means the protocol stopped declaring tiers at all, which is a structural break rather than drift.

confidence_declared.why: Exact, log-only. Note the values themselves are degenerate (zero 'low' across 141 routes), so this gates that the field is populated, NOT that it means anything.

outcome_recorded.why: Exact, log-only. Set below current so ordinary variation does not trip it.

outcome_recorded_live.why: Excludes the 38 bulk-backfilled rows, so it measures outcomes captured as observations. The weakest of the exact metrics, floored low to catch regression without being aspirational.

outcome_is_observation.why: Transcript-derived, so it carries the coverage caveat: a fall in the ATTRIBUTION rate must not be read as a fall in adherence.

hint_before_route.why: Floored just below current purely to detect further decay. 28.6% is not an acceptable state, it is the state, and the target below is where this needs to go.

Protocol step 3 says run hint before routing. Measured per route it happens 28.6% of the time; the per-session reading of 64% is a different question and does not discharge this one. 60% is a deliberate half-measure: some routes legitimately ride an earlier hint in the same session, so 100% would be the wrong goal.

outcome_recorded_live.why: Every backfilled outcome is a label invented after the fact. Getting this up is what makes the outcome variable worth anything.
